newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS sees very pleasing result for 1997.
newsitem.headline: UBS sees very pleasing result for 1997.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) had a very good start to the current year and it was confident of a very pleasing group result for the full year, UBS chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta said in a speech prepared to the annual shareholders' meeting.
"The results for the first quarter are not yet available in their entirety, but it is already clear that we have had a very good start to 1997," Cabiallavetta said.
"January and February were exceptionally good months, although March was weaker," he added.
Cabiallavetta said it would be rash to predict "record earnings" for the full year on the basis of first quarter figures and conditions on financial markets could change abruptly.
"We are confident, however, that we will be able to report a good interim result on August 5 and very pleasing group results for the year on February 6, 1998," he said.
